mechanism_reconstruction.formula: 1+0.865617*ln(rounded_duration_ticks/minimum_rounded_ticks); same formula as read source, plus a head-width/minNoteDistance floor.
mechanism_reconstruction.method: Only one force per complete observed1q two-group span is calibrated; there is no per-gap fit. All.1q/.05q ticks are exact at480PPQ.
mechanism_reconstruction.limits: Measured ink width is a proxy, not a direct runtime query of noteHeadWidth. Errors below0.001sp include that distinction and SVG rounding.
